text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One early afternoon, I'm headed toward my office, when…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Grass! I heard you beat Spe!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah… Well, that match was, um… a different grade, you see…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! So, you overheard us! There's this cool competition happening in the shopping district! It's called…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The "Take On the Legendary Special Week! ★ Oodles of Noodles Ramen-Eating Challenge"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that? They're calling Spe legendary now! Doesn't that sound amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And guess what! I asked the ramen shop owner and there are two spots available!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So we should both sign up, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But Urara… Could you actually finish a meal like that? You always eat less than me during lunch.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine! I'll just skip breakfast!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the question is whether it is really that simple…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, now that I think about it… We're talking about becoming legends here. So, as much as it hurts me to say it…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll just have to skip my carrot ice cream, too! I'll sacrifice it all to beat Spe!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Urara…
choice_data_list: Let's beat her in a race instead!
We gotta take on this challenge!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's right! Racing is so much more exciting than just stuffing your face.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hohoho… That's true!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ramen would fill up my belly, but racing fills up my soul!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey! I'll become a legend by racing instead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the help of Grass Wonder, Haru Urara just narrowly avoids an overfull stomach and a bellyache.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm going to become a legend! The Legendary Urara!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, what strong resolve you have! I hope both of you put up a good fight, then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Did you not just exclaim "We gotta take on this challenge!"? Well, you have my full support!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're gonna try too, Trainer? Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's both give it our all! Then we'll be legends together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We find out the "legendary" Spe is quite the ferocious opponent. When it's all said and done, I decide to take a break from even looking at ramen for the next few weeks…
